Sophie (Sales): Pathfinder (CTO Leila) is asking for an exec bridge — two blockers holding the POC: committed SLA for tail latency at 1k TPS, and details on Okta SSO + BYO-KMS. Can legal/infra/price confirm availability for a 9am PST bridge tomorrow?
Alex (SE): Seen. I can pull a short SLO/arch note. Do we have target p99 latency and token profile for the POC?
Sam (Infra): Need concrete numbers. Is the 1k TPS sustained or bursty? Also need to know egress targets for their VPC peering.
Sophie (Sales): Leila said sustained for 30m windows, p50 ~ 30ms, p99 target <= 250ms. Egress estimate: ~400GB/day during peak.
Patrick (Eng): For that profile we can hit p99 <=250ms on dedicated nodes with batching tuned. Suggest quantized model variant (8-bit) for cost parity. Will add a canary fallback to a cheaper variant if tail spikes.
Alex (SE): Quick pricing delta: dedicated pool for POC + support = baseline $18k/month, enabling BYO-KMS adds a one-time integration engineering fee ~$6k, optional SLA bump to 99.95% + priority on-call + runbook = $4k/mo. Rough numbers, will confirm.
Noor (Finance): Those numbers look okay as a draft. We need to lock the term length for the SLA uplift (min 3 months) to amortize on-call.
Maria (Legal): On BYO-KMS + SSO we need Pathfinder to sign our standard DPA + section on key custody. Also they requested subprocessor list & SOC2 attestation; legal will push the SOC2 report and a narrow redline for key-handling.
Carmen (CS): I’ll prep the exec bridge agenda and invite Leila + their CISO. Can someone upload a one-pager on the architecture and the network playbook? I have a template: https://redwood.internal/presales/exec-bridge-template (internal).
Alex (SE): Uploading a 1-pager now. Also adding a small curl snippet to show auth flow for Okta SSO -> Redwood:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Okta-Assertion: <assertion>" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Sam (Infra): Network playbook notes: allowlist required on 10.9.0.0/16 for peering, TLS 1.3 enforced, mTLS optional for backend. For BYO-KMS we support external HSM via our KMIP bridge.
Maria (Legal): I’ll draft the DPA + narrow KMS clause. Will need CISO contact to confirm key custody expectations before we sign.
Sophie (Sales): OK — action items: Alex finalize 1-pager + cost breakout by EOD, Patrick and Sam confirm perf runbook and failure/fallback notes, Maria prepare DPA redline and list of docs to send, Noor confirm billing term for SLA, Carmen schedule the 9am PST exec bridge and invite. If we can hit those, I’ll update Leila.
deploy-bot: Reminder: add presales docs to the shared folder /sales/presales/pathfinder (auto-created).
Alex (SE): Done — uploaded 1-pager and cost table: https://redwood.internal/files/pathfinder-presales (internal). Marked items in doc with TODOs for legal/infra.
Sophie (Sales): Thanks — looping in Leila now. @Maria (Legal) please ping when DPA is ready so I can attach to the calendar invite. :thumbsup:
Maria (Legal): Will do. Targeting a draft in 6 hours.
Noor (Finance): I’ll confirm the 3-month minimum SLA term and reply here before EOD.
Patrick (Eng): We’ll run a quick end-to-end perf run on a staging shard tonight to validate p99 numbers; will post logs in this thread.
Sophie (Sales): Perfect — closing for now. If anyone hits a blocker, @ here.
__comment: This doc models a realistic internal sales escalation thread for POC blockers (pricing, SSO, BYO-KMS, SLA).
